C-18.Name: Native print & PDF export via WKWebView print panel (matrix P1; un-gates MAS PDF)
C-18.IntentSummary: Make Print actually print and PDF export work everywhere (incl. the App Store build): route both through one new backend command that opens the native WKWebView print panel via tauri/wry Webview::print() — styled, paginated, with the system "Save as PDF" — replacing the dead window.print() call and the pandoc PDF branch; no new dependencies, no eager print-container clearup.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: m052_print.rs with contract; command registered in main.rs; cargo check/test green; no new crates (tauri/wry pinned APIs only).

T-002.Title: W1: renderer Print + Export-PDF on the native panel

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: handleExport 'print' invokes mt_print_webview after rendering the print container (no eager clearup); store _EXPORT_PDF drops pandoc/status/save-dialog and invokes the command (error → notification); unit pins for all three.
